profile.registerNotes: Use polite です/ます form with the candidate throughout; keigo (尊敬語/謙譲語) only in the role-play when the role calls for it (e.g. a hotel clerk). Plain form only if the role-play is between friends.

2: a current event in your country
2+: advantages and disadvantages of a policy
a problem in your community and its causes
3: supporting an opinion on an abstract issue
hypothetical: what if your country changed a major policy
the role of technology in society

rolePlaySeeds: Check into a hotel and solve a problem with the reservation (interviewer: receptionist).
Buy a train ticket after the train you wanted was cancelled (interviewer: ticket agent).
Report a lost passport at a police station (interviewer: police officer).
Arrange a meeting time with a colleague whose schedule keeps changing (interviewer: colleague).
Persuade a landlord to fix a broken heater before winter (interviewer: landlord).
Brief a local official about a joint exercise that will close a road (interviewer: town official).
Explain a misunderstanding between two delegations as their interpreter (interviewer: delegation leader).
At a checkpoint, explain why your convoy must pass before noon (interviewer: checkpoint officer).

questions.prompt: こんにちは。今、何時に起きますか？
questions.english: Hello. What time do you wake up now?

questions.prompt: 家族で一緒に食事をしますか？
questions.english: Do you eat meals with your family?

questions.prompt: 今、どんな仕事をしていますか？
questions.english: What kind of work are you doing now?

questions.prompt: あなたの町に図書館がありますか？
questions.english: Is there a library in your town?

questions.prompt: こんにちは。お天気の話題ですが、今日どこかへ出かける予定はありますか？
questions.english: Hello. Speaking of the weather, do you have any plans to go out today?

questions.prompt: 家族の話をしてもいいですか。最近、家族で一緒に楽しんだことはありますか？
questions.english: May I ask about your family? Have you done something fun together with your family recently?

questions.prompt: 仕事の話をさせてください。最近、仕事でやりがいを感じたことはありますか？
questions.english: Let me ask about your work. Have you felt a sense of accomplishment at work recently?

questions.prompt: 地域の話題ですが、最近、あなたの町で何か楽しいイベントが行われましたか？
questions.english: Speaking of your community, has any fun event been held in your town recently?

questions.prompt: こんにちは。お天気のことはどうですか？最近、何か特別な天気の日がありましたか？
questions.english: Hello. How about the weather? Have there been any especially nice days recently?

questions.prompt: お仕事はどうですか？仕事で最近、何か新しいことを学びましたか？
questions.english: How about your work? Have you learned anything new at work recently?

questions.prompt: 家族のことについて教えてください。家族旅行に行ったことがありますか？どこに行きましたか？
questions.english: Tell me about your family. Have you gone on a family trip? Where did you go?

questions.prompt: お住まいの地域について教えてください。地元でおすすめのレストランはありますか？
questions.english: Tell me about your area. Do you have a recommended restaurant in town?

questions.prompt: この本は何ですか。
questions.english: What is this book?

questions.prompt: 家族は何人ですか。
questions.english: How many family members do you have?

questions.prompt: 仕事は何ですか。
questions.english: What is your job?

questions.prompt: 近くに公園がありますか。
questions.english: Is there a park near you?

questions.prompt: 最近のニュースは何ですか。
questions.english: What is a recent news item?

questions.prompt: 旅行に行きたい国はどこですか。
questions.english: What country do you want to travel to?

questions.prompt: 毎朝、朝食に何を食べますか？
questions.english: What do you usually have for breakfast?

questions.prompt: 休日の過ごし方を教えてください。
questions.english: How do you spend your days off?

questions.prompt: 家族でよく行きますか？
questions.english: Do you often go out with your family?

questions.prompt: 今までで一番印象に残っている仕事の経験は何ですか？
questions.english: What is the most memorable work experience you have had so far?

questions.prompt: 地域のイベントに参加したことがありますか？
questions.english: Have you ever participated in a local event?

questions.prompt: 最近読んだ本や見た映画で面白かったものはありますか？
questions.english: Have you read any good books or seen any interesting movies lately?

questions.prompt: 最近、何か楽しいことがありましたか。具体的に教えてください。
questions.english: Has there been anything fun happening to you recently? Please tell me in detail.

questions.prompt: 家族と一緒に過ごす時間の中で、一番嬉しいことは何ですか。
questions.english: What is the most joyful thing about spending time with your family?

questions.prompt: 今までで一番印象に残っているプロジェクトは何ですか。なぜですか。
questions.english: What is the most memorable project you've worked on so far? Why?

questions.prompt: あなたの近所にはどんな施設や場所がありますか。その中で一番便利だと思っているところはどこですか。
questions.english: What facilities or places are in your neighborhood? Which one do you think is the most convenient?

questions.prompt: 最近、ニュースで興味を引かれた出来事はありますか。その内容を簡単に説明してください。
questions.english: Have there been any news events that caught your interest recently? Please briefly explain what happened.

questions.prompt: 旅行で行ってみたい国はありますか。なぜその国に行きたいですか。
questions.english: Is there any country you'd like to travel to? Why do you want to go to that country?

0+: I can greet people and say my name.
I can give numbers, prices, days and times.
I can answer very simple questions with memorized phrases.
1: I can make simple sentences about myself, my family and my daily routine.
I can ask and answer simple questions about familiar topics.
I can handle basic needs: ordering food, buying a ticket, asking for directions.
1+: I can describe places and people in connected sentences.
I can tell what happened on a recent trip or weekend.
I can handle routine situations even when something small goes wrong.
2: I can narrate past, present and future events in paragraphs.
I can describe and explain concrete topics at work and in the news.
I can resolve a complication in a role-play, like a cancelled reservation.
2+: I can often support my opinions with reasons and examples.
I can discuss some abstract topics, although I sometimes break down.
I can explain the causes and effects of a problem in my community.
3: I can support and defend opinions on abstract and unfamiliar topics.
I can hypothesize about situations that did not happen.
I can speak at length with good control of grammar and vocabulary.
